verification.title: Verification evidence
verification.description: Run your check command in this task’s project directory. Each execution is saved separately; changed code requires a new check.
verification.empty: No check results yet. Task completion does not mean verification passed.
verification.changedDuringRun: Code changed during this check; this result cannot verify the current code.
verification.head: Original Git commit
verification.truncated: Output truncated; each stream retains at most 64 KiB.

completion.title: Completion and acceptance
completion.acceptanceStale: Previous acceptance no longer applies to the current result, criteria, code or check evidence. Review and accept again.
completion.criteriaHelp: Saving criteria clears prior acceptance. Only the latest run of every required command can count, and it must pass against current code. The written definition is reviewed by you.
completion.manualHelp: No automated checks are required. Manual acceptance records your review; it does not mark checks as passed.
completion.unsaved: Save the changed criteria before running required checks or accepting.
completion.blocked: Finish the task and pass every required check on current code before accepting.
